modules.concept_title: Female Reproductive System: Anatomy, Gametogenesis & Fertilization Site
modules.why_needed: Visually grounds the anatomical sites of gametogenesis, oviductal fertilization, and uterine implantation essential for CBSE/ICSE 5-mark board exam questions.
modules.what_to_explain: 1. Point out the paired almond-shaped ovaries responsible for egg maturation and estrogen secretion. 2. Trace the fallopian tube (oviduct) and fimbriae where fertilization occurs. 3. Highlight the muscular uterus and rich vascular endometrium where the zygote implants. 4. Identify the narrow cervix and vaginal birth canal.
modules.what_to_make: Coronal cross-section with bilateral symmetry: Ovaries, Fallopian tubes (oviducts) with fimbriae, pear-shaped muscular Uterus with endometrial lining, Cervix, and Vagina. Pure white background #FFFFFF.
modules.timing_and_cue: Call render_svg_diagram during Step 2 of Socratic cadence

modules.concept_title: Electromagnet: Current-Induced Magnetic Field with Soft Iron Core
modules.diagram_title: Electromagnet: Solenoid, Soft Iron Core & Magnetic Field
modules.why_needed: Illustrates how current-carrying helical coils induce a strong, switchable magnetic field amplified by high magnetic permeability soft iron, contrasting temporary vs permanent magnets in board exams.
modules.what_to_explain: 1. Point out the cylindrical soft iron core that provides high magnetic permeability. 2. Trace the insulated copper wire windings carrying conventional current from positive to negative terminal. 3. Show the induced North and South magnetic poles at coil ends. 4. Trace the continuous closed magnetic field loops emerging from North and entering South.
modules.what_to_make: Horizontal soft iron core cylinder, helical copper wire coil turns, DC circuit with battery and key, continuous closed magnetic field loops from North to South, polarity labels N/S, and formula B = μ · n · I.
modules.timing_and_cue: Call render_svg_diagram during Step 2 of Socratic cadence
